name: subminer
description: All-in-one sentence mining overlay with AnkiConnect and dictionary integration

scripts.get-frequency:electron: bun run build:yomitan && bun build scripts/get_frequency.ts --format=cjs --target=node --outfile dist/scripts/get_frequency.js --external electron && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron dist/scripts/get_frequency.js --pretty --color-top-x 10000 --yomitan-user-data ~/.config/SubMiner --colorized-line
